Context boosting reaches only so far: a keyword lifts a weak value's score
only when it sits inside the window of a few words on either side. These
lines probe that boundary with the same weak value (a bare bank-account
number, which carries no checksum and stays below the threshold on its own)
and an "account" keyword placed at different distances.

In window (keyword within the few-word span, value should be boosted and
detected):
  The account on file is 123456789012 for you.

Out of window (keyword pushed well past the span by filler words, so the
value stays weak and undetected):
  The account, according to the note we filed away last quarter, was 987654321098.

The first value is close enough to "account" to cross the threshold; the
second is too far, so it must survive un-redacted even though the word
"account" does appear earlier in the sentence.
